versions.changelog: v3: Architect-Builder pattern (Buck does I/O, subagents do cognitive work only). API-first for simple fixes. No hardcoded models. No emoji rule. Three difficulty levels. Council of LLMs optional for L3.
v2.1: Add 3 difficulty levels (Easy/Intermediate/Advanced) with per-level search queries, timeouts, scope thresholds, and optional Council review for L3
v2.0: Rewritten to use subagent orchestration pattern. Intermediate difficulty (not good-first-issue). Researcher + Worker subagent pipeline. Real code fixes via AI, not heuristic scripts.
Initial release with graduated complexity levels
